paper_title: MMAR A Challenging Benchmark for Deep Reasoning in Speech, Audio,   Music, and Their Mix
caption: Different Audio-Language models’ performance on MMAU (test-mini) and MMAR.
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the performance of three different audio-language models—Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, Audio-Reasoner, and Qwen2.5-Omni—on two evaluation benchmarks: MMAU (test-mini) and MMAR, with accuracy expressed as a percentage on the vertical axis ranging from 0 to 70 in increments of 10. The horizontal axis lists the three models, each represented by a pair of adjacent vertical bars: blue for MMAU and purple for MMAR, as indicated by the legend in the upper left. For Qwen2-Audio-Instruct, the MMAU accuracy is approximately 49%, while MMAR accuracy is around 30%. Audio-Reasoner achieves about 61% on MMAU and 36% on MMAR. Qwen2.5-Omni shows the highest performance with approximately 65% on MMAU and 56% on MMAR. The bars are grouped by model, with MMAU consistently outperforming MMAR across all three models, and Qwen2.5-Omni achieving the highest scores on both benchmarks.
